annotations.title: Build a 50-950 color palette from one color

description: Use when the user asks for a palette, shades, tints, a design-token scale or a Tailwind-style 50 to 950 ramp from a brand color. Returns 11 steps that keep the hue, with the hex, contrast on white and on black, and the best text color for each step. Example: {"color": "#ff5a1f", "name": "brand"}.

name.description: Token name used in the CSS and Tailwind output. Default "brand".
